products.title: TORI HALFORD DOUBLE-LAYER BAMBONI® BLANKETS
products.body_html:
Wrap yourself in unmatched softness with the Double-Layer Bamboni Blanket, available in Throw and XL sizes. Made with two layers of our best-selling Bamboni fabric (80% poly microfiber and 20% rayon from bamboo), this blanket delivers an ultra-plush, cozy feel that invites rest, warmth, and connection.

This blanket was inspired by Tori's two angel babies, Boone and Blaklee, and is a symbol of enduring love, offering a sense of peace and comfort through every season. Whether draped over your sofa or wrapped around you at night, it’s a beautiful reminder that love surrounds us, always.
